Categories 10/11 are created by FUN_1002e1d0 (0x1002e1d0.c:36) from 0x10093a10.c:30-31, which runs after FUN_10012f40 (0x10082810.c:11 -> 0x1001bb60.c:27, then 0x10082810.c:29).
meta.index: (op << 8) + (leftCat << 4) + rightCat. Shift globals DAT_1018ee4c=8 and DAT_1018ee48=4, DAT_1018ee50=10 initial categories (bytes@0x1018ee48..0x1018ee53).
meta.wildcards: EXPANDED: "cells" lists every reachable non-null cell explicitly for the 12 categories that exist at runtime (0..11). Categories 12..15 are never returned by any class (only two dynamic categories are ever registered), so their cells are omitted. Prefix operators are looked up with leftCat=0 (0x1002af4b.c:84) and postfix operators with rightCat=0 (0x1002af4b.c:61); registered cells that can never be looked up (prefix with leftCat!=0, postfix with rightCat!=0) are omitted. "registrationsSummary" keeps the 16x16 counts per handler; "undefinedCells" lists the reachable cells with no handler.
meta.diagonalNote: When categories 10 and 11 were added, FUN_10011550 copied column/row 0 into the new column/row and set [op][N][N] = null for every op (0x10011550.c:65-77). So vector&&vector, vector||vector, vector?vector, vector:vector (and the same four for quaternion pairs) have no handler and raise "Operator %d not defined for operands!". observed (pseudocode emulated in tools; see values.md).
meta.callingConvention: binary: handler(left, right) (bytes@0x1002b0dd: push right; push left; call eax). prefix: handler(NULL, operand) (bytes@0x1002b02b: push operand; push 0). postfix: handler(operand, NULL) (bytes@0x1002afa2: push 0; push operand). Each handler returns a new reference; the interpreter releases the operands afterwards (0x1002af4b.c:75-79, 98-100, 125-129).
meta.missingHandler: A null cell raises runtime error 3 "Operator %d not defined for operands!", %d = operator index in decimal (0x1001b6e0.c:61).
meta.notInTable: Operator 0x1C "=" compiles to opcode 0C ASSIGN (0x10005340.c:11) and is never looked up here. All other binary operators, including && || ? :, compile to a plain BINOP after both operands (0x10005340.c:17): no short-circuit evaluation.
